sensitivePublic.title: Public repos with sensitive-sounding names
sensitivePublic.what: Names like secret, token, keys, backup, internal — double-check they should be public.

staleNotArchived.title: Not touched for over a year
staleNotArchived.what: No push in 12+ months but not archived — archive to show they're finished.

dormant.title: Quiet for 6–12 months
dormant.what: Still open, but no push for half a year.

empty.title: Empty repositories
empty.what: Created, but nothing was ever pushed.

abandonedForks.title: Forks you never changed
abandonedForks.what: Forked and left as they were — safe to delete in most cases.

noDescription.title: No description
noDescription.what: The About box is empty — people can't tell what it is.

noTopics.title: Public repos without topics
noTopics.what: Topics make repos findable on GitHub.

noLicense.title: Public repos without a license
noLicense.what: Without a license nobody may legally reuse the code.

oversized.title: Over 500 MB
oversized.what: Very large — maybe build output or binaries got committed.

masterBranch.title: Default branch still "master"
masterBranch.what: GitHub's default is "main" now — rename in Branches if you like.
